findings: Rearm is k_attempt_reset, issued in REARM; the coordinator next enters DRAIN.
DRAIN requires normal_retired, instantiated with as_retired; as_retired requires !as_busy && !as_core_cfg_valid.
Reader rearm goes CORE_RESET -> CFG_SEND -> CFG_WAIT -> CFG_REPLY -> IDLE. Pending cfg_rsp_valid contributes to busy/retired gating until consumed.

Normal successful request goes OWNER_SEND -> OWNER_WAIT -> REPLY; codec response is consumed only when drained. KA source waits in AW for the authority response, then processes the owner before its next AS.
Reader fault suppresses request ready; authority fault feeds coordinator abort. Faulted and simultaneous-transition paths require executable checking before asserting global stall unreachability.
Reconfiguration completion k_rcfg_done is cf_rsp_valid from config_restore, not directly an authority-ready signal; do not replace this distinction with an assumed equality.
